A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] was an engagement in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] in the very close [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul system]], the New Republic forces decided to continue their progression by liberating [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="TEA" />

Thyferra was freed but the New Republic didn't settle on the planet which stayed officially neutral in the war. Thyferra was in fact in trouble due to significant tensions between Humans and Vratix and between the [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra]] and [[Zaltin Corporation]].<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'' novel series]]</ref>
